entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane littered with ancient hedrons, the setting of the Booster Quest game.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A brackish, benighted jungle region of Zendikar.

entities.name: Nirkana
entities.description: An outpost near the edge of Guul Draz with a single kor outfitter.

entities.name: Pelakka Karst
entities.description: A dreaded system of limestone gullies and murky canals in Guul Draz.

entities.name: Hagra Cistern
entities.description: Ancient sinking ruins in a vast inland basin of marshes, hiding vast treasure.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: A vampire city near Guul Draz.

entities.name: Hedron
entities.description: An ancient, magical, diamond-shaped stone of Zendikar whose fragments the player collects; the last piece is in a vault.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A dreaded demon who posed as an oracle of Mul Daya to have the hedron assembled, seeking vengeance for his lost planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Thelzaia
entities.description: A powerful vampire bloodchief known for greed for ancient relics, guarding a hedron fragment with null zombie minions.

entities.name: Mul Daya tribe
entities.description: A tribe of elves the false oracle claimed to belong to.

entities.name: Pelakka Wurm
entities.description: A wurm that attacks the party in Pelakka Karst.

entities.name: Swamp crocodiles
entities.description: Crocodiles in the marshes near Hagra Cistern that drag a scout under.

events.summary: A hooded oracle claiming to be of the Mul Daya tribe gives the party a map into Guul Draz promising valuable magic.
events.quote: gives you a map to lead you somewhere within the brackish, benighted region of Guul Draz

events.summary: The party finds the first hedron fragment in a marsh grotto and overcomes its warding spell.
events.quote: Inside is a fragment of a large, rough-hewn hedron

events.summary: The party stumbles upon a vampire hunting party near Malakir.
events.quote: you've stumbled upon a hunting-party of vampires

events.summary: In the Karst the party faces Thelzaia and her null zombies for the second hedron fragment.
events.quote: But guarding it is Thelzaia, a powerful vampire bloodchief known for her endless greed for ancient relics

events.summary: Swamp crocodiles attack the expedition near Hagra Cistern.
The party obtains the last hedron piece and assembles it.
events.quote: You unseal the crypt and obtain the last piece of the hedron.

events.summary: The oracle reveals himself as Ob Nixilis, who plans vengeance on Zendikar with the hedron.
events.quote: it's Ob Nixilis, the dreaded demon.

events.summary: The player strikes down Ob Nixilis and reseals the hedron in the crypt.
events.quote: You strike down Ob Nixilis, who disappears in a haze of black mana.

relations.note: Seeks vengeance on the world for destroying his spark.
relations.quote: which he says he will use to exact vengeance on this world for destroying his lost planeswalker spark

relations.note: Outpost near the edge of Guul Draz.
relations.quote: The outpost of Nirkana, near the edge of Guul Draz

relations.note: The Karst surrounds and feeds the basin holding the Cistern.
relations.quote: The Pelakka Karst surrounds and feeds a vast inland basin
